Definition: from G5104 and G3568; truly now, i.e. accordingly:--then, therefore.
BiblicalUsage: Therefore, then — the word Paul uses to press the argument home. I therefore so run, he says, not as uncertainly, and Hebrews says let us go forth therefore unto Him without the camp, bearing His reproach.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word carries the whole weight of the argument before it: because this is true, do this.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
